subject: Learning Methods
title: Self-Compassion Over Self-Criticism
description: A 60-second lesson on Self-Compassion Over Self-Criticism.

hook.text: Students who forgave themselves for procrastinating in one session procrastinated less in the next.

buildup.text: Self-criticism after failure creates shame, which triggers more avoidance.

discovery.text: Self-compassion breaks the cycle. Acknowledging the slip without judgment frees cognitive resources for getting back.

twist.text: Self-compassion isn't self-indulgence. It means treating yourself as you would treat a friend who stumbled.

climax.text: When you procrastinate, say: that happened. Now what is my next small step? Forgive, then focus forward.

punchline.text: Forgive the slip. Take the next step. Move forward.

quiz.question: Why does self-criticism after procrastinating make the problem worse?
options: Shame triggers more avoidance, continuing the cycle
